resources.string: Turn on Enable AI and Allow AI network requests before fetching models or testing the connection.
Network access is allowed. Requests start only when you fetch models or test the connection.
Uses the address, key and selected model above to send a fixed short test. A small charge may apply. A successful test does not save changes.
Enter a valid HTTPS API address without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
Enter a valid API key without spaces or line breaks.
Choose or enter 1 to 32 models, with at most 128 characters per model ID.
Enter a Provider name without line breaks or control characters.
You can save up to 16 Providers. Remove an unused configuration first.
